anatomy.title: Anatomy of one
anatomy.subtitle: The lead engine I built at Group Quimera. A message lands on WhatsApp and no human touches it until a salesperson is pinged. Follow one lead through it.
anatomy.whatsapp_desc: A prospect writes to the business number. The WhatsApp Business API hands the message to the workflow the moment it arrives.
anatomy.n8n_desc: n8n pulls out the name, phone and what the person is asking about, and checks the data is complete and valid before anything else happens.
anatomy.crm_desc: A lead is created in the CRM with its source and interest already filled in, so nobody copies anything by hand.
anatomy.postgres_desc: The same record is written to PostgreSQL in real time, so the database and the CRM always agree.
anatomy.rep_desc: The right salesperson is notified with the lead's details and can reply straight away, while the prospect is still interested.
anatomy.sample_message: Hi! I saw your ad and I'd like more information and prices, please.
anatomy.sample_alert_body: Carla Rojas is asking about pricing. Her details are already in the CRM; reply on WhatsApp.

hero.subtitle: Data & Automation Engineer in Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia.

story.title: The short version
story.p1: I started out writing web applications for small businesses in Santa Cruz. What ended up interesting me was not the screens but what happened behind them: people copying data between systems, reports that did not reconcile, hours lost to work a machine could do.
story.p2: So I moved toward data and automation. I built ETL pipelines processing millions of records a day, a corporate data warehouse with proper dimensional modelling, and workflows connecting WhatsApp, CRMs and databases in real time. The part I care about is the measurable part: 50% faster loads, 40% less time per lead, 95% report reliability.
story.p3: I work with clients in Bolivia and the United States, in English and Spanish. Lately I spend a lot of time wiring LLMs into real business processes, which is where I think most of the interesting work is right now.
story.p4: Outside client work I build my own products: software for people in Santa Cruz who solve things with a paper notebook today.
